description: Header file defining platform-specific functions and data structures for converting Qt key sequences to native hotkey representations on Windows, Linux, and Mac platforms.

classes.name: UKeyData
classes.description: Data structure holding key and modifier information for hotkeys on Linux and Mac platforms.

methods.name: QtKeyToWin
methods.description: Converts Qt key code to Windows virtual key code, specifically mapping function keys.

methods.name: QtKeyToLinux
methods.description: Converts a Qt key sequence to a Linux-specific key data structure, mapping keys and modifiers.

methods.name: QtKeyToMac
methods.description: Converts a Qt key sequence to a Mac-specific key data structure, mapping keys and modifiers.
